abstract: Fourty-seven years old male was admitted to this hospital with the symptoms of worsening cough and chest pain. An anterior mediastinal tumor, 13 cm in diameter, was pointed out on chest X-ray. The tumor was diagnosed as primary mediastinal germ cell tumor with mixed seminomatous and non-seminomatous elements due to elevated serum AFP and beta HCG, and the pathological finding of needle biopsy specimen. He underwent 3 courses of chemotherapy with BEP regimen, and following surgical resection of the tumor, left upper lobectomy and partial resection of pericardium via median sternotomy. Pathological diagnosis of the resected tumor was mature cystic teratoma. For 9 months no recurrence of the tumor has been observed.
abstract_ja: 47歳男性が咳嗽および胸痛の悪化で当院を受診した。胸部X線で直径13 cmの前縦隔腫瘍が指摘された。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびβ-hCGの上昇と、針生検の病理所見から、セミノーマ性および非セミノーマ性成分を伴う原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。BEP療法を3コース施行した後、正中胸骨切開により腫瘍の外科的切除、左上葉切除および心膜部分切除を行った。切除標本の病理診断は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった。9か月間再発は認められていない。
